text_simplified: The text discusses the importance of raising children upon religious values and akhlaq (moral character), emphasizing the necessity of monitoring children’s behavior and guiding them toward what is right. It also mentions some of the challenges parents face in the tarbiyah (upbringing) of their children amid external influences.

review_defects.why: The Arabic refers to a single set of values that are both religious and moral (القيم الدينية والأخلاقية). The English splits this into 'religious values' and a separate concept 'akhlaq (moral character)', altering the meaning from 'moral values' to 'character'.
